title: Claude Code via InferHub + local LiteLLM

files.notes: Interactive model picker + seat apply + Claude Code start
Windows double-click entry that invokes the .ps1

secrets_policy.repo_rule: This module only stores sanitized launchers and docs. Secrets stay outside the repo.

dependencies: Local LiteLLM workbench at D:\claude\litellm (repo Pukujan/litellm-ckff-ops)
Claude Code CLI available as `claude` on PATH
Desktop configs/.env providing LITELLM_MASTER_KEY or LITELLM_PROXY_KEY
summary: Pick a main and optional advisor model from the InferHub Top 20 list, apply seating aliases through the unified local LiteLLM proxy, then launch Claude Code against http://127.0.0.1:4000.
